name: Important Windows Service Terminated Unexpectedly
description: Detects important or interesting Windows services that got terminated unexpectedly.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Rare false positives could occur since service termination could happen due to multiple reasons
query: winlog.channel:System AND ((winlog.provider_name:Service\ Control\ Manager AND event.code:7034) AND (winlog.event_data.param1:*Message\ Queuing* OR (winlog.event_data.Binary:(*4d0053004d005100* OR *6d0073006d007100*))))
